### Honoring God's Sovereignty - Today's Insight - August 5, 2021
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-august-5-2021.html
Passage: Daniel 4:34-35
Points:
- Frequent anxieties reveal our human desire for self-reliance, requiring our pride to be leveled before God.
- Believers do not need full explanations of life's events because the Lord does as He pleases in heaven and on earth.
- God actively directs human history, seasons, and personal circumstances across the globe.
- Believers find genuine peace by resting in God's sovereignty rather than demanding control over their situations.
- Eternal security belongs to those who anchor their trust in Jesus Christ as Lord.

### Praying the Names of God - November 29
Author: Ann Spangler
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/prayingnamesgod/praying-the-names-of-god-december-9.html
Passage: Daniel 4:34
Points:
- Calling God the Most High (*Elyon*) acknowledges that His power, mercy, and dominion remain unmatched.
- Nebuchadnezzar's reason returned only when he looked upward and praised the eternal King.
- Earthly troubles like financial stress, illness, or broken relationships never exceed God's authority.
- Sheltering in the Most High requires cultivating regular habits of prayer, repentance, obedience, and trust.
- Lasting rest and confidence come from dwelling in the care of the God for whom nothing is impossible.
